title: Find the display names of users who own posts that are linked to post ID 61
question: Find the display names of users who own posts that are linked to post ID 61217 and have received at least one comment containing a URL. Also, return the total number of such comments per user.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name, COUNT(c.XCL_005) AS comment_count
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
INNER JOIN postLinks pl ON p.XCL_026 = pl.XCL_023
INNER JOIN comments c ON p.XCL_026 = c.XCL_006
WHERE pl.XCL_024 = 61217
  AND c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%'
GROUP BY u.XCL_052, u.XCL_055
